sentence: This project helps researchers use gene sequencing and computer tools to study inflammation and build gene regulatory networks.
This project studies how lactate changes the molecular networks that guide muscle stem cells as they repair muscle.
This project supplies human bladder cancer tissue samples and handles their collection, storage and sharing for cancer research.
This project brings together researchers who study how the immune system controls tumors and who develop immune-based therapies for patients with cancer.
This project tries to find out how neutrophils fight tumors during T cell therapies and how they take part in immune-related side effects.
This project studies the strategies and brain mechanisms that humans use to learn about their environment and update decision-making.
This project studies the functions, mechanisms and evolution of reverse transcriptases and related retroviruses, and uses RNA sequencing to study human diseases.
This project builds computer tools that combine spatial transcriptomics, histology images and single cells to show how tissues are organized.
This project follows a cohort of Hispanic cancer survivors to find out which factors shape symptoms, quality of life and mortality.
This project provides metabolomics services and builds custom methods that use mass spectrometry to analyze cancer research samples.
This project tries to find out whether a type of interneuron connects to specific pyramidal and interneuron populations in the cortex.
This project provides full veterinary diagnostic testing services and works with a laboratory network to investigate cases.
This project uses behavioral experiments, genetic analyses and computational modeling to find out what shapes the Approximate Number System in children and non-human primates.
This project offers sequencing and data analysis services so researchers can study the microbiome and gene function in digestive diseases.
This project builds machine-learning models that use electronic health records to predict recurrence and death after an ischemic stroke.
This project tests a targeted drug combination with an antibody-drug conjugate for resistant triple-negative breast cancer and looks for biomarkers to guide its use.
This project studies the genes that are turned on or off in patients with airway disease as part of their chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
This project uses a human brain organoid model to find out how mutations in one gene disrupt early brain development in epilepsy.
This project tests whether an injectable, biodegradable, electrically conductive hydrogel helps neural progenitor cells mature in a model of spinal cord injury.
This project tries to find out how autoreactive T cells differ from normal cells in autoimmune diseases.
